description: Local-first real-time voice agent interface with Supervisor orchestration, a specialized agent pool, and Hermes escalation
releasePolicy: The first release permits read-only operations and explicitly allowlisted local reversible operations only. Externally visible, paid, irreversible, and high-impact actions must return BLOCKED_POLICY and must not execute.

features.name: WebSocket Event Bus & Binary Transport API
features.description: Implemented WebSocket client/event bus with JSON event schemas, protocolVersion, monotonic server seq tracking, and APIs for binary frame multiplexing. This verifies the transport skeleton; it does not prove that the current microphone sends PCM or that the server consumes audio.

features.name: Connection Resilience & Session Recovery
features.description: Implemented reconnect backoff, stable sessionId, lastSeq resume requests, heartbeat/liveness handling, and visible connection state. Existing tests verify deterministic client behavior rather than a production Hermes replay service.

features.name: Deterministic Mock Server & JSONL Session Replay
features.description: Implemented deterministic fixture replay, mock WebSocket events, and JSONL recording/replay utilities for UI development. Recorded traces and fixtures remain the required basis for deterministic CI.

features.name: Agent Manifest Consumption & Dynamic Constellation
features.description: Implemented AGENT_MANIFEST consumption, dynamic agent descriptors, active constellation state, and current bridge-side profile discovery. This is a presentation capability, not proof of Supervisor scheduling.

features.name: UI Agent State Machine
features.description: Implemented optimistic UI transitions and backend-event reconciliation for listening, thinking, speaking, executing, interruption, completion, and error visuals. It does not implement the new backend job scheduler.

features.name: Browser Microphone UI, Web Speech Prototype & Input Fallbacks
features.description: Implemented getUserMedia plus AnalyserNode RMS visualization, browser SpeechRecognition transcription where available, push-to-talk interaction, and text fallback. AudioWorklet PCM uplink, server VAD/ASR, real TTS, and audible streaming playback are explicitly not covered by this completed prototype feature.

features.name: Interruption Contract Prototype
features.description: Implemented UI-triggered playback-queue stop and USER_INTERRUPT dispatch while preserving task events. This verifies cancellation semantics against mocks; it does not prove acoustic VAD barge-in or real TTS interruption latency.

features.name: Audio-Reactive Central Orb
features.description: Implemented the central agent orb, state labels/icons, and microphone/TTS-volume-reactive animations using available prototype telemetry.

features.name: Active Satellite Constellation & Delegation Visuals
features.description: Implemented dynamic satellite orbs and delegation beams driven by manifest and task events. The UI visualizes summaries and does not need the internal Supervisor routing graph.

features.name: Gesture Controls & Targeting Intent
features.description: Implemented touch/click mode controls and USER_TARGET intent dispatch. The backend remains responsible for interpreting targeting intent under the active orchestration architecture.

features.name: Responsive Mobile & Desktop Layout
features.description: Implemented mobile voice-room drawers and desktop three-pane layout with independently collapsible transcript and task panels.

features.name: Streaming Transcript Panel
features.description: Implemented incremental transcript rendering, text deltas, agent badges, code formatting, artifacts, and scroll behavior against protocol events and fixtures.

features.name: Read-Only Task Tree & Execution Summaries
features.description: Implemented a read-only task tree from TASK_START, TASK_PROGRESS, and TASK_COMPLETE events. Internal jobId, routeId, retry, and worker-attempt traces remain backend observability data by default.

features.name: Supervisor Runtime Boundary & Superseding ADR
features.description: Define the local Qwen Supervisor as the primary orchestrator for routing and agent-pool tracking, define Hermes as an escalation worker, locate each runtime component, and replace contradictory Hermes-only invariants through a superseding ADR and synchronized product/protocol documentation. The versioned migration must derive the orchestrator from AGENT_MANIFEST.isOrchestrator and enumerate all production behavior that hardcodes the hermes identity.

features.name: Supported Linux GPU Runtime Preflight
features.description: Provide a functioning WSL2 Linux distribution or GPU-enabled Linux container on the Windows host, verify Linux-side NVIDIA access, pin compatible runtime versions, and complete a Qwen3-ASR streaming smoke test. Native Windows vLLM and community forks are not assumed supported baselines.

features.name: Canonical Trace Context & Strategic Logging Policy
features.description: Define and propagate traceId, sessionId, turnId, revisionId, taskId, jobId, parentJobId, routeId, agentId, and attempt. Store structured route/job/error/latency records with sampling, redaction, retention, and backpressure policies. The Web UI receives only public task summaries.

features.name: Deterministic Voice Corpus & Benchmark Harness
features.description: Create versioned fixed audio and event fixtures with expected VAD boundaries, transcript revisions, route labels, policy blocks, cancellation outcomes, and terminal states. Separate deterministic CI replay from hardware/model benchmarks and record sample-size/confidence methodology.

features.name: AudioWorklet PCM Capture, Resampling & Uplink
features.description: Replace browser SpeechRecognition on the primary path with secure-context getUserMedia capture, applied-setting verification, AudioWorklet processing, measured 16 kHz mono resampling, tunable frame sizing and pre-roll, bounded buffering, and binary WebSocket uplink. Preserve text and push-to-talk fallbacks.

features.name: Server PCM Ingestion & Silero VAD
features.description: Consume rather than discard client PCM, maintain per-session audio buffers, run Silero VAD as the authoritative endpoint detector, support onset pre-roll and endpoint grace, and emit measurable speech-boundary events without relying on live microphones in CI.

features.name: Qwen3-ASR 1.7B Streaming Service
features.description: Run the official vLLM streaming path, emit partial/final text, record VAD-derived timing, avoid assuming streaming timestamps or calibrated confidence, expose health/backpressure signals, and prove target-host latency and VRAM behavior.

features.name: Transcript Stabilizer & Chinese-English Glossary
features.description: Maintain stablePrefix, tentativeSuffix, and revisionId; derive stability from hypothesis agreement/churn; preserve commands, paths, names, acronyms, and technical terms; invalidate speculative routes after meaning-changing revisions.

features.name: Deterministic Commands & First-Release BLOCKED_POLICY
features.description: Recognize unambiguous stop-speaking, cancel-task, continue, status, and repeat commands before generative routing. Permit only read-only operations and explicitly allowlisted local reversible operations in the first release; deterministically block externally visible, paid, irreversible, and high-impact actions. No WAITING_APPROVAL state or approval protocol is included.

features.name: Structured Local Supervisor Routing
features.description: Serve Qwen3 1.7B as a narrow Supervisor that emits schema-validated route, reasonCode, confidence, riskClass, costBand, deadlineMs, and worker-role decisions. Calibrate confidence and compare BF16/quantized configurations rather than assuming 12 GB co-residency.

features.name: Agent Pool Registry, Job Scheduler & Delegation Tracking
features.description: Implement manifest-driven logical worker roles, bounded queues, parent/child jobs, concurrency limits, deadlines, heartbeats, state transitions, and public task summaries. Replace hardcoded hermes behavior in mode, state, manifest, transcript, and constellation paths; select the center orchestrator by isOrchestrator. A role may share a runtime; named roles do not imply one resident model per agent.

features.name: Hermes Escalation, Budget & Circuit Breaker
features.description: Escalate difficult reasoning or low-confidence cases to Hermes with bounded retry, timeout, cloud budget, circuit-breaker, degraded local response, and trace propagation. Hermes is not assumed available or the default route.

features.name: Cancellation Isolation, Retry & Idempotency
features.description: Keep USER_INTERRUPT response-scoped and TASK_CANCEL task-scoped; preserve valid background completion events; suppress stale voice responses; propagate explicit cancellation only to cancellable descendants; enforce retry budgets and idempotency keys for side-effect-capable adapters.

features.name: Real Streaming TTS & Audible Browser Playback
features.description: Select and integrate a measured TTS backend, stream correlated audio chunks, replace simulated playback timing with actual AudioWorklet or equivalent non-blocking output, detect underruns, and fall back to text when synthesis or playback fails.

features.name: Response Coordinator & Stale-Result Suppression
features.description: Order worker/Hermes results, stream text at safe sentence/clause boundaries, correlate output with trace/turn/task revisions, suppress cancelled or superseded voice responses, and preserve task status updates independently from speech focus.

features.name: Acoustic Barge-In & Echo Robustness
features.description: Verify actual browser AEC settings, output-reference suppression, VAD behavior during TTS, and push-to-talk degradation. Achieve measured interruption latency without allowing USER_INTERRUPT to cancel background jobs or speaker echo to self-interrupt.

features.name: Bilingual ASR, Routing & Policy Evaluation
features.description: Evaluate Mandarin, English, and natural code-switching separately against versioned labels. Measure transcript accuracy/stability, key-term preservation, command correctness, route quality, policy blocking, and worker outcomes with documented scoring rules.

features.name: Latency, VRAM, Thermal & Reliability Benchmark
features.description: Measure p50/p95 and statistically qualified p99, first-audio latency, queue wait, cancellation latency, underruns, total-board/per-process VRAM, idle baseline, thermals, cost, and long-run terminal-state reliability on the RTX 4070 Ti host.

features.name: Service Recovery & Release Evidence
features.description: Provide health checks, startup ordering, bounded restarts, failure/status reporting, WSL/container recovery documentation, deterministic test proof, hardware benchmark artifacts, and a final evaluator report before any new feature passes are set true.

deferred.name: User Approval Protocol for Consequential Actions
deferred.reason: The first release blocks consequential actions instead of executing them. A later release may define approval request/decision events, exact action previews, expiry, revision binding, and WAITING_APPROVAL.

deferred.name: WebRTC Audio Transport
deferred.reason: WebSocket remains the baseline until measured latency or network behavior justifies ICE/STUN/TURN complexity.

deferred.name: Streaming Word-Level ASR Timestamps
deferred.reason: The official Qwen3-ASR streaming mode does not return timestamps. Optional post-final forced alignment remains outside the first-response hot path.
